Supplier catalogue showing a broad part family — LOWER WEST SIDE

A fictional supplier catalogue repeats CHI-CORE-05 as a part-family code for several compatible assemblies. It is not a unique serial number. A matching catalogue family does not establish that two observations concern the same physical part.
